items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: Very much like that Sleepy John Estes deal, you know.

ctx.x: Well, Negroes. All of these were Negroes there in Dallas. Yes, down there in that Negro section there. They got to where they looked forward to my coming up there. And they'd all get on the phone and call up. And they'd all come over there. We'd have little jam sessions, little substandard instrumentation, I'm sure. Anything they'd have, they'd bring up. French harp. Very much like that Sleepy John Estes deal, you know. The harmonica, whether you... Hammer and Nixon, is it? Anyway, all kinds of players. Any of…
The main instruments were piano and guitar.
